# Security policy

## Report a vulnerability

Report it privately. Open the repository's **Security** tab, choose **Report a vulnerability**. Only the maintainers can see the report.

Please do not open a public issue or post the details in Discussions.

Include what you found, the version you tested (the app version or the release tag), the steps to reproduce it, and what someone could do with it. A short proof of concept helps. Do not test on servers or accounts that are not yours.

## What to expect

The maintainer reads private reports as they come in. There is no set response time. You will hear back about whether it can be reproduced, and when a fix ships you will be credited if you want that.

## Supported versions

Fixes go to the latest release and to `main`. The Mac app updates itself. If you run your own server, update to the latest release.

## Scope

In scope: the Mac app, the server (the web app and its API), the iPhone app, and the plug-in system.

Out of scope: the services the app connects to (AI providers, Apify, Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Cloudflare and the social platforms). Report problems in those to the provider.
